results.title: Odisha under red alert, low-pressure system intensifies
results.description: Odisha is set to receive very heavy rainfall over the next 24 hours under the influence of a low-pressure area, the India Meteorological Department ( IMD ) said on Thursday. According to reports, IMD issued a red alert in view of the expected weather conditions. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely to continue till August 16. Low-Pressure Area Moving Northwestwards The well-marked low-pressure area over the North Bay of Bengal and adjoining Bangladesh-West Bengal coast moved northwestwards. As of 5:30 am on Thursday, it centred over the West Bengal coast and adjoining Bangladesh and the northwest Bay of Bengal. The system is likely to move northwestwards through Gangetic West Bengal towards Jharkhand . It is likely to intensify into a depression within the next 12 hours. Advisory Issued For Fishermen In view of the conditions, fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea. Also Read: Odisha weather news: State braces for heavy rain due to low-pressure area over BoB Authorities continued to closely monitor the weather system and its likely movement as the state braces for continued rainfall over the coming days.
